text: 311 Toronto (Toronto at Your Service) provides residents, businesses, and visitors with easy access to non-emergency City services, programs, and information in more than 180 languages over the phone and 132 languages via the 311 Toronto online portal. Toronto at Your Service handles Tier 1 requests, which includes general information requests about City programs or general service requests (e.g., reporting an issue, requesting maintenance, etc.) on behalf of its five Integrated Service Divisions (ISDs) - Solid Waste Management Services, Transportation Services, Toronto Water, Municipal Licensing and Standards (including Toronto Animal Services) and Parks, Forestry and Recreation - Urban Forestry.
